Gundam Heads...!! And there are even more of them now...!!
What the...? I sense powerful Minus Energy coming from the other side of this wall...
I am Geronimon, the Monster Chief.
I've been itching to cut loose!
Why are these guys here!? Where the hell did they come from!?
I have the power to revive monsters too!! Lord Belial thinks very highly of me for it!!
I can't let you lot go any further than this.
Now, boys, get 'em!! Go wild all you like!!
Damn... To think I'd lose... But all that waits for you up ahead is hell...
Geronimon can use psychic powers to revive monsters. It must have revived those two as well!
Sheesh! The damn things sure gave us a hard time.

notes.note: #0.316-#0.330 is a 15-variant leader block that 0711.bla never displays (script ends at #0.279), so no Pt_Chara_Check order applies; voiced from wording. Identical Japanese (#0.323-#0.328) kept identical. #0.329 polite (Mebius/OOO-style), #0.330 casual/rough.

0712.bla only shows #0.1 (Gundam Head roar); #0.2 speaker not recovered (unused or set elsewhere). Kept speaker-neutral; plural 'Gundam Heads' from 'their number is increasing'. #0.3 is the Yes/No battle prompt.
Leader block #0.2-#0.16 (15 variants, all identical Japanese, identical English). The '?party' label is right; the trace's last constant name (Black RX) is just the last variant loaded.

0715.bla: Pt_Chara_Check 11-15 (Ultraman, Seven, Taro, Mebius, Zero) say this line - the Ultras recognise Geronimon; ids 1-10 get #0.8-#0.17 'What are you...!?'. Label shift: slice puts '?party' on #0.9 but the block starts at #0.8 (#0.7 is empty); all ten identical anyway.

Unused alternate (no MessWinSet hits #0.19-#0.22, #0.24-#0.25, #0.30-#0.36). Geronimon's self-introduction/boasts/defeat lines; speaker inferred as Geronimon from content (uses ore, calls Belial 'Lord'). Glossary gives Geronimon g=n, so Seravee's #0.38 uses 'it'.
New roars, no prior English for this Japanese: Red King 'Gugaaaaaah...!!', Gomora 'Gwoooooooh...!!'; Geronimon growl 'Grrrr...' (#0.1/#0.23/#0.39 identical).
Ankh's 'kuru zo' rendered 'Here they come!' since Geronimon plus the two revived monsters attack together.

0716.bla Pt_Chara_Check order 8,7,6,10,9,2,1,5,4,3,12,11,15,14,13 = God, Zeta, Nu, 00, Wing Zero, RX, Rider 1, OOO, W, Den-O, Seven, Ultraman, Zero, Mebius, Taro. #0.10 (only variant with rough 'takee') = Den-O Sword Form/Momotaros, confirming the order; the rest identical.
Narration; 'me no mae' rendered 'before their eyes' (third person, matching narration style).

report: 80/80 rows. Speakers verified against 0711/0712/0713/0715/0716 bytecode. Unused alternates: 0711 #0.323-0.330 (whole block after #0.279 never shown), 0715 #0.19, #0.24-0.25, #0.30-0.36 (Geronimon lines, speaker inferred). 0715 label shift: second leader block starts at #0.8, not #0.9. New roars: Red King 'Gugaaaaaah...!!', Gomora 'Gwoooooooh...!!', Geronimon 'Grrrr...'. New term: 'Monster Chief' (Geronimon's title, not in glossary).
